surface: Specific daily trader jobs backed by Birdeye Data

skills.name: birdeye-5-minute-trending-tokens
skills.title: 🔥 5-Min Trending Tokens
skills.question: What tokens are trading most actively in the last five minutes?
skills.description: Scan liquid Solana tokens ranked by five-minute trading volume with practical market-cap, liquidity, holder and activity filters.

skills.name: birdeye-launchpad-trending-tokens

skills.question: What tokens are trending on a launchpad right now?

skills.name: birdeye-launchpad-new-tokens
skills.title: 🛫 Launchpad New Tokens

skills.name: birdeye-pumpfun-trending-tokens

skills.name: birdeye-pumpfun-new-tokens

skills.name: birdeye-newly-listed-tokens

skills.name: birdeye-near-graduation-tokens

skills.name: birdeye-recently-migrated-tokens

skills.question: What recently migrated tokens meet practical liquidity and market-cap thresholds?

skills.name: birdeye-5-minute-volume-surge
skills.title: 📈 5-Min Volume Surge

skills.name: birdeye-5-minute-price-surge
skills.title: 💹 5-Min Price Surge
skills.question: What liquid tokens are surging most over five minutes?

skills.name: birdeye-5-minute-most-traded

skills.question: What tokens have the most trades in the last five minutes?
skills.description: Rank liquid Solana tokens by five-minute trade count to surface immediate on-chain attention.

skills.name: birdeye-smart-money-token-radar
